summary: Register a sole proprietorship or limited company through RDB or Irembo.

en.title: Apply for a Rwandan Visa
en.summary: Apply for a tourist, business, or transit visa online or on arrival.

summary: Apply for a tourist, business, or transit visa online or on arrival.

documentChecklist.fallbackOption: Must be valid for at least 6 months

en.title: Enroll in Mutuelle de Sante

documentChecklist.fallbackOption: Tenancy agreement, utility bill, or village chief letter

text.en: Learn greetings: Muraho (hello), Waramutse (good morning), Wiwe (good afternoon).
text.fr: Apprenez les salutations: Muraho (bonjour), Waramutse (bon matin), Wiwe (bon apres-midi).
text.rw: Iga kumwe: Muraho, Waramutse, Wiwe.

text.en: Learn polite phrases: Murakoze (thank you), Mbabarira (sorry), Ndakubabarira (excuse me).
text.fr: Apprenez les phrases polies: Murakoze (merci), Mbabarira (desole), Ndakubabarira (excusez-moi).
text.rw: Iga amagambo y'ubwuzu: Murakoze, Mbabarira, Ndakubabarira.

text.en: Practice with locals and don't be afraid to make mistakes.
text.fr: Pratiquez avec les habitants et n'ayez pas peur de faire des erreurs.
text.rw: Zigeranya n'abaturage kandi utinye gukora amakosa.

commonPitfalls: Start with greetings before asking questions

summary: Key emergency contacts and basic safety advice for Rwanda.

text.en: Save emergency numbers: Police 112, Ambulance 912, Fire 111.
text.fr: Enregistrez les numeros d'urgence: Police 112, Ambulance 912, Pompiers 111.
text.rw: Bika nimero z'ikoranabuhanga: Polisi 112, Ambulance 912, Umuriro 111.

text.en: Know the nearest hospital or police station to your home and workplace.
text.fr: Sachez l'hopital ou le commissariat le plus proche de votre domicile et lieu de travail.
text.rw: Menya ibitaro cyangwa ibiro bya polisi biri hafi y'inzu yawe n'aho ukora.

text.en: Keep copies of important documents in a safe place.
text.fr: Gardez des copies des documents importants dans un endroit sur.
text.rw: Bika amakopi y'inyandiko z'ingenzi ahantu hahirwe.

commonPitfalls: Emergency services may require payment upfront
